notes: Perf fix for v0.49.0's SMS parser rebuild: the broader keyword-based extraction was recompiling regex patterns on every single message instead of once, which made a full-inbox history scan noticeably slower on real devices. Also checkpoints the scan's resume point every 25 messages instead of after every single one, cutting disk writes during a large scan. No behavior change to what gets captured - same parsing rules as 0.49.0, just much faster.
